label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is TP: User-controlled Referer header value flows through URL decoding and HashMap retrieval to 'bar' which is written to response via format() without HTML encoding. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string) is FP: The format string 'java.util.Locale.US' is a constant, not user-controlled—the tainted value goes into the second argument (bar), not the format string position.

evidence.note: User input from Referer header (line 45) flows through decode (line 51), HashMap storage/retrieval (lines 53-56), to bar (line 60) which is formatted to response without HTML encoding—confirms XSS vulnerability
Format string 'java.util.Locale.US' is a constant literal, making the tainted-format-string alert a false positive despite bar being tainted
